title: eng-releases
text:
eng-releases

deploy-bot: Starting rollout v2.4.1 -> production (dedicated) across regions: us, eu, apac. Commit: 6f3b2a9. Change window: 22:00-02:00 UTC. :rocket:
Marta: ack — I'll watch metrics and traces for the first 30m.
Sanjay: tagging release on our side: `git tag -a v2.4.1 -m "prod rollout" 6f3b2a9` then pushing.
Lee: heads-up: we pinned config to `quant-profile=v2` for this rollout to keep latency stable.
deploy-bot: us: STARTED on pool-gpu-1 (zone us-central1).
Marta: seeing warmup traffic, no errors yet. CPU on router a is ~55%.
deploy-bot: eu: STARTED on pool-gpu-3 (europe-west1).
ops-bot: alert (anomaly): 5min spike in eu p50 latency +120ms, small error rate bump (0.6%).
Jamie: noted. rolling back eu to v2.4.0? or pin to earlier kernel?
Sanjay: let's try pinning model variant to `redwood/decoder-1.3-quant` for EU and reobserve. If still bad, rollback.
Lee: applied variant pin for eu -> `decoder-1.3-quant`. config push done.
Marta: eu latency recovered to baseline in ~6m after pin. errors cleared. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: us: FINISHED successfully on pool-gpu-1. commit 6f3b2a9. Duration: 8m.
deploy-bot: eu: PARTIAL FINISH — live on variant `decoder-1.3-quant` (pinned), commit 6f3b2a9. Note: kernel fallback in effect.
Jamie: APAC canary next; moving slow to watch tail latency.
deploy-bot: apac: STARTED on pool-gpu-5 (asia-east1) — canary 5% traffic.
Marta: APAC canary seeing small increase in memory churn on worker 12, but no OOMs.
ops-bot: metric alert: apac worker 12 memrss rising > threshold.
Sanjay: pausing APAC canary. execute rollback-to-stable on apac canary group.
deploy-bot: apac: PAUSED. Rolling canary back to previous config (v2.4.0 variant `decoder-1.2`).
Lee: created deploy pin: `region:apac -> pinned_version: v2.4.0` in deployment config so auto rollouts won't resume.
Jamie: creating a short incident note in #incidents with timeline and mitigation.
Marta: overall status: US ✅, EU ✅ (pinned variant), APAC paused & pinned to v2.4.0. No customer-impacting errors reported.
Sanjay: follow-up actions: 1) run regression test for apac memory profile, 2) investigate kernel selection diff between apac/eu, 3) update release notes with pin and rollback rationale.
deploy-bot: ROLLOUT SUMMARY: us: success, eu: success with variant pin, apac: paused+rollback. Commit: 6f3b2a9. Links: CI run: https://ci.redwood.dev/6f3b2a9 , Release notes draft: https://docs.redwood.dev/releases/v2.4.1-draft
Marta: thanks all. I'll keep this thread pinned for the postmortem and next deploy window. :pushpin:
ops-bot: Created ticket RED-4921 for APAC memory regression triage.
Jamie: i'll prep the post-deploy changelog and notify support about APAC pin.
Sanjay: good run — closing monitoring watch after one more hour if stable.
Marta: closing thread in 60m unless new issues.
